The '''Battle of Aguarl 3''' was a brief engagement of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] [[0 ABY/Legends|approximately six months after]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], in which a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] struck at a [[Aguarl Rebel base|sub-aquatic Rebel base]] on [[Aguarl 3]].

{{Battle-stub}}

==Background==
{{Quote|The destruction of the Death Star shows how dangerous the Rebellion has become.''"<br />"''Now the Mon Calamari Rebels have infected the oceans of Aguarl 3.|The squadron leader and [[Seth (Imperial)|Seth]]|<ref name="Roc1" />}}
Following intelligence provided by a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] spy, the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] ''[[Ravagor]]'' swiftly deployed a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa Bombers]] to destroy the Rebel base hidden under the seas of [[Aguarl 3]]. Assigned to the task were the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Willks]], [[Rawst]], [[Parrot (pilot)|Parrot]] and [[Ranulf Trommer/Legends|Ranulf Trommer]].<ref name="Roc1" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Accelerate to attack speed! Let's blow that Rebel base into perdition.|TIE/sa Bomber wing leader|<ref name="Roc1" />}}
The Rebel Base under command of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] quickly detected the fighter squadron, activating the Rebel [[Air mine|anti-air emplacements]]. The mines swiftly destroyed all but one target, the bomber piloted by Ranulf Trommer. Although his craft had sustained damage, Trommer successfully launched three [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], striking the base's launch bay and flooding the facility, forcing the Rebels to evacuate.<ref name="Roc1" />

==Aftermath==
Returning to the ''Ravagor'', Trommer and his smoking ship were recovered by the Star Destroyer's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and brought to the flight deck. [[Firefighter droid/Legends|Imperial Firefighting droids]] hosed down the craft and recovered the critically injured Trommer, rushing him to surgery and saving his life at the cost of his leg. Disgusted by his [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] replacement, Trommer endeavored to hide it in his return to service, seeing it as dishonorable.<ref name="Roc1" /><ref name="Roc2">[[River of Chaos 2|''River of Chaos'' 2]]</ref>

Ranulf Trommer's single-handed victory in the engagement led him to be known as the "Hero of Aguarl 3" to both the Empire and Rebel Alliance, and earned him an appointment to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Grigor (governor)|Grigor's]] [[Imperial garrison (M'haeli)|garrison]] on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]] as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Lynch Hauser]]<ref name="Roc1" /><ref name="Roc4" />
